method: Rendered all pages with PyMuPDF and visually inspected three complete six-page contact sheets; final source/paper edits rerendered and all final pages reviewed.
findings: Title/date and anonymous metadata correct. No clipping, overlap, broken symbols, missing characters or overflowing lines. Main result/source table, exact unresolved question, proof map, complete source appendix, chronology and full bibliography are legible and located as signposted.
